assumptions: The engine chosen matches the question: exact k-mers, windowed identity, or windowed matrix score.
limits: The three engines answer different questions and their scores are not comparable.
A dot plot shows similarity; it does not call homology.
bio.jane/contract.question: Where does this sequence resemble itself or another, as a dot plot of repeats, inversions and shared regions?

description: Self-similarity or pairwise comparison of the subject as a dot plot — repeats, inversions and shared regions. Three real engines: exact k-mer (FlexiDot/dottup), windowed identity (seqinr) and windowed substitution-matrix scoring (EMBOSS dotmatcher), which answer different questions.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

best_path_only.description: reduce forward segments to a non-overlapping best path (EMBOSS dotpath). Only applies when engine is word. Advanced.

convert_wobbles.description: expand IUPAC ambiguity codes so a wobble matches what it stands for (FlexiDot). Only applies when engine is word. Advanced.

dedupe.description: drop the duplicate runs dotmatcher's two passes leave on the shared diagonal. Off matches upstream; a caller that COUNTS runs wants it on. Only applies when engine is matrix. Advanced.

engine.description: exact k-mer (blind to diverged repeats) · windowed identity · matrix-scored windows (the only one that grades a substitution). Values: word (Exact k-mer (dottup)), window (Windowed identity (seqinr)), matrix (Substitution matrix (dotmatcher)).

matrix.description: which substitution matrix scores the windows. Unset picks EDNAFULL for nucleotide and EBLOSUM62 for protein, as EMBOSS dotmatcher does. Values: EDNAFULL (EDNAFULL (nucleotide)), EBLOSUM62 (EBLOSUM62 (protein)). Only applies when engine is matrix. Advanced.

matrix_text.description: a custom scoring matrix in EMBOSS/NCBI format, overriding `matrix`. Only applies when engine is matrix. Advanced.

max_cells.description: refuse rather than compute past this many window comparisons. A ceiling, not a target: raise it for a large pair. Only applies when engine is window. Advanced.

max_unknown_percent.description: percentage of a k-mer allowed to be N (or X for protein) before it is skipped. In %. Only applies when engine is word. Advanced.

min_matches.description: positions inside the window that must agree for it to be marked (seqinr `nmatch`). At 1 almost every window qualifies; raise it toward the window length to demand real identity. Only applies when engine is window.

other.description: the sequence to compare against — wire a record or name a library document; leave unset for self-vs-self.

reverse_complement.description: also plot matches against the reverse complement (k-mer engine). Only applies when engine is word.

shift.description: phase offset applied to the second sequence's windows (seqinr `shift`). Only applies when engine is window. Advanced.

step.description: residues between window starts (seqinr `wstep`). 1 compares every position. Only applies when engine is window. Advanced.

threshold.description: score a window must reach (EMBOSS default 23). Only applies when engine is matrix. Advanced.

word_size.description: k for the k-mer engine, or the window length for the other two. In bp.

name: dot_plot

coverage.description: fraction of the subject covered by at least one forward match (0–1)

longestForward.description: residues on the longest uninterrupted forward run

plot.description: the full result — segments or points, plus axis lengths

stats.description: longest runs, run counts and per-sequence coverage
